name: abap2ui5-samples-controls
description: Generated abap2UI5 ports of the official UI5 demo kit samples.

scripts.check: npm run gates && npm run check:app-rules && npm run check:keywords && npm run check:summary && npm test
scripts.gates: npm run check:chains && node scripts/check-prose-names.mjs && node scripts/pattern-lint.mjs && node scripts/check-pins.mjs && node scripts/check-archive.mjs && node scripts/validate-meta.mjs && node scripts/structural-diff.mjs --strict && node scripts/data-fidelity.mjs && node scripts/check-mcp-contract.mjs && node scripts/generate-overview.mjs && node scripts/generate-coverage.mjs && node scripts/generate-status.mjs && node scripts/generate-samples-md.mjs && node scripts/generate-catalogue.mjs && node scripts/check-catalogue-contract.mjs && node scripts/generate-derived.mjs --quiet && git diff --exit-code -- src README.md api.md STATUS.md SAMPLES.md catalogue.json catalogue-derived.json
scripts.gates:full: npm run gates && npx abaplint ./abaplint.jsonc && node scripts/view-gates.mjs --strict && npm run check:collection
scripts.syfixes: find src -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.downport: node scripts/downport-guard.mjs && abaplint --fix .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc && npm run syfixes && cp -f .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc abaplint.jsonc && npm run abaplintpathfix
